Package ro.ase.ppoo.ebanking.service

Class BancaService

java.lang.Object
ro.ase.ppoo.ebanking.service.BancaService
public class BancaService extends Object
Serviciul principal de gestiune a operatiunilor bancare in memorie. Implementeaza cerintele academice PPOO: - 2 masive fundamentale (1D: double[] rate de schimb, 2D: double[][] volume lunare tranzactionate) - 3 colectii de obiecte (Map de ContBancar, List de Tranzactie, Set de Client) - Toate modificarile se realizeaza exclusiv in memorie pe parcursul sesiunii.
